title: Example manifest
description: The single source of truth for one example. tools/check_conformance.py validates every examples/*/example.yaml against this, and cross-checks runtime.identifier against the Terraform variable default and the CloudFormation parameter default so the three cannot drift.

name.description: Must equal the directory name. Used for the release tag and the CI matrix.

title.description: One-line human title for the README table.

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what it does and what it talks to.

status.description: planned exempts the example from the required-file-set check. Nothing else is exempt.

platform.description: Where it runs. A field rather than a directory level, so the CI matrix and release tags stay derivable from ls examples/.

runtime.description: Required for lambda-zip and container-image. identifier is authoritative: the Terraform variable default and the CloudFormation parameter default must match it.

identifier.description: Lambda runtime identifier, or the language version for a non-Lambda deliverable.

preview_alternative.description: A public-preview runtime a deployer may opt into. Never the default: preview runtimes carry no SLA and no support.

lambda.description: Required when deliverable is lambda-zip. Drives the packager.

package_root.description: Directory under the example holding the importable package, relative to the example root.

rely_on_runtime_aws_sdk.description: Exclude boto3/botocore and their dependencies from the deployment package and use the copy the Lambda Python runtime provides. Trades a ~16 MB zip for a ~50 KB one; the cost is that the runtime's SDK version changes under you during an automatic runtime update. Only set this true when the example uses long-stable APIs.

destinations.description: Grafana Cloud surfaces this example writes to.

iac.description: Paths to the IaC, relative to the example root. Both are required for a non-planned aws example.

component.description: release-please component name. Must equal `name`, because it is also the required commit scope.

notes.description: Free-text caveats surfaced in the release notes.
